newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - October 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Sri Lanka expresses concern over attitude and activities of some United Nations humanitarian and development agencies based in island.
Thousands of commuters stranded after heavy seas wash away 100 metres of railtrack between Katukurunda and Kalutara.
Shell Gas Lanka raises price of gas cylinder by 25 rupees to 300 rupees in second price hike in five months.
Tamil Tiger rebel chief Velupillai Prabhakaran said to be hiding in jungles of southern Mannar, intelligence officials say.
Fourteen refugees drown off Mannar after trying to flee to India in overloaded boat.
Navy arrests 111 Tamil refugees off Mannar trying to flee by boat to south India.
Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadirgamar slams United Nations missions in Sri Lanka.
